# Hoydoon: Real Estate, Apartments, Mortgages & Home Values

The leading real estate marketplace. Search millions of for-sale and rental listings, compare Hoydoon® home values and connect with local professionals.

## General Information

- [About us](https://www.hoydoon.com/about): Provides an overview of Hoydoon, its mission, and services offered in the real estate market.
- [Help](https://www.hoydoon.com/helpcenter): A resource for users seeking assistance with the platform, including FAQs and support options.
- [Terms of use](https://www.hoydoon.com/terms): Outlines the legal agreements and conditions for using the Hoydoon platform.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.hoydoon.com/policy): Details how Hoydoon collects, uses, and protects user data.

## User Actions

- [Login](https://www.hoydoon.com/auth/sign-in): Access your Hoydoon account to manage listings, saved searches, and personal information.
- [Register](https://www.hoydoon.com/auth/sign-up): Create a new account to start using Hoydoon’s features and services.
- [Download App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hoydoon/id6736393320): Link to download the Hoydoon mobile application for real estate searches on the go.

## Real Estate Services

- [Buy](https://www.hoydoon.com/buy): Explore options for purchasing homes, including listings and mortgage information.
- [Rent](https://www.hoydoon.com/rent): Find rental properties and learn about the rental process through Hoydoon.
- [Sell](https://www.hoydoon.com/sell): Information and resources for homeowners looking to sell their properties.
- [Find an agent](https://www.hoydoon.com/agent): Connect with local real estate agents to assist with buying, selling, or renting properties.

## Market Insights

- [Understanding the Real Estate Market Trends](https://www.hoydoon.com/article/article-details): An informative guide on current trends in the real estate market, helping users make informed decisions.
